easy: The season after summer when leaves fall off the trees and the air gets cool.

ex.en: We jump in piles of red leaves every fall.
ex.ko: 우리는 가을마다 빨간 낙엽 더미에 뛰어든다.

easy: To take air into your body through your nose or mouth and let it out again.

ex.en: I breathe deeply before I jump into the pool.
ex.ko: 나는 수영장에 뛰어들기 전에 숨을 깊이 들이쉰다.

easy: Kept secret, so only a few people are allowed to see it.

ex.en: The map was classified, so only a few people could see it.
ex.ko: 그 지도는 기밀이어서 몇 사람만 볼 수 있었다.

easy: A small ad in a newspaper that sells something or asks for something.

ex.en: Dad put a classified ad in the newspaper to sell our old bike.
ex.ko: 아빠는 낡은 자전거를 팔려고 신문에 분류 광고를 냈다.

easy: A small thing that holds papers or other things together.

ex.en: I used a clip to hold my homework papers together.
ex.ko: 나는 숙제 종이를 클립으로 묶었다.

easy: A secret plan made by a few people to do something wrong.

ex.en: The movie is about a conspiracy to steal the king's crown.
ex.ko: 그 영화는 왕관을 훔치려는 음모에 관한 것이다.

easy: A secret plan to do something bad, often to take power.

ex.en: The story is about a conspiracy to take the throne from the young prince.
ex.ko: 그 이야기는 어린 왕자에게서 왕위를 빼앗으려는 음모에 관한 것이다.

easy: A big argument where people strongly disagree.

ex.en: There was a controversy about whether our school should have a longer lunch.
ex.ko: 우리 학교 점심시간을 늘려야 하는지를 두고 논란이 있었다.

easy: To face a problem or trouble while you are doing something.

ex.en: We encountered a big problem when our model volcano fell apart.
ex.ko: 우리는 모형 화산이 무너졌을 때 큰 문제에 부딪혔다.

easy: A set of questions to show how much you know.

ex.en: I studied all night for my spelling exam.
ex.ko: 나는 철자 시험을 위해 밤새 공부했다.

easy: Looking at something very carefully to find mistakes.

ex.en: The teacher gave my paper a careful examination.
ex.ko: 선생님은 내 시험지를 꼼꼼하게 살펴보셨다.

easy: A big group made when several smaller groups join together.

ex.en: Many soccer clubs joined together to make a federation.
ex.ko: 많은 축구 클럽이 힘을 합쳐 연맹을 만들었다.

easy: A group of states or countries that join together but still make some of their own rules.

ex.en: Australia is a federation of states.
ex.ko: 호주는 여러 주로 이루어진 연방이다.

easy: A grown-up who takes care of a child or of someone's things.

ex.en: My aunt is my guardian while my parents travel.
ex.ko: 부모님이 여행 가신 동안 이모가 내 보호자이다.

easy: A person who has no home to live in.

ex.en: Our class collected warm coats to give to the homeless.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 노숙자들에게 줄 따뜻한 외투를 모았다.

easy: A tool that you need skill to use well.

ex.en: The doctor used a special instrument to look in my ear.
ex.ko: 의사 선생님은 특별한 기구로 내 귀 속을 들여다보았다.

easy: Stepping in to help stop a fight or a problem.

ex.en: The teacher's quick intervention stopped the argument.
ex.ko: 선생님이 재빨리 끼어들어 다툼이 멈췄다.

easy: A person who really, really likes something.

ex.en: My brother is a dog lover and wants five puppies.
ex.ko: 우리 형은 개 애호가라서 강아지를 다섯 마리나 키우고 싶어 한다.

easy: The ideas or ways that most people follow.

ex.en: That singer is part of the musical mainstream, so everyone knows her songs.
ex.ko: 그 가수는 음악의 주류에 속해서 모두가 그녀의 노래를 안다.

easy: A list of the foods you can order at a restaurant.

ex.en: I read the menu and ordered noodles.
ex.ko: 나는 메뉴를 읽고 국수를 주문했다.

easy: All the foods that are served in one meal.

ex.en: Tonight's menu is soup, rice, and fruit.
ex.ko: 오늘 저녁 메뉴는 국, 밥, 과일이다.

easy: A list on a computer screen that shows choices you can click.

ex.en: I clicked the menu to pick a new game.
ex.ko: 나는 메뉴를 눌러 새 게임을 골랐다.

easy: Felt or done by both sides in the same way.

ex.en: The love between my dog and me is mutual.
ex.ko: 나와 우리 개는 서로를 사랑한다.

easy: A feeling of being angry or hurt because of something someone said or did.

ex.en: She took offense when her brother laughed at her drawing.
ex.ko: 그녀는 오빠가 그림을 보고 웃자 기분이 상했다.

easy: Doing something wrong or against the rules.

ex.en: Cheating on a test is a serious offense at our school.
ex.ko: 우리 학교에서는 시험 부정행위가 심각한 잘못이다.

easy: Said out loud with your voice, not written down.

ex.en: Tomorrow I give an oral report, so I will talk instead of write.
ex.ko: 내일 나는 구두 발표를 한다. 쓰는 대신 말로 할 것이다.

easy: Having to do with the mouth.

ex.en: Brushing is part of good oral care.
ex.ko: 양치질은 좋은 구강 관리의 일부이다.

easy: Groups of people who share the same country or culture.

ex.en: Many peoples of the world celebrate the new year.
ex.ko: 세계의 많은 민족이 새해를 기념한다.

easy: To chase or follow someone to catch them.

ex.en: The dog pursued the squirrel across the yard.
ex.ko: 개가 다람쥐를 쫓아 마당을 가로질러 달렸다.

easy: To go after something you want, like a goal or hobby.

ex.en: I want to pursue my dream of becoming a vet.
ex.ko: 나는 수의사가 되는 꿈을 추구하고 싶다.

easy: Something you must do as part of a job or class.

ex.en: Reading ten books is a requirement for the summer reading club.
ex.ko: 책 열 권 읽기는 여름 독서 모임의 필수 조건이다.

easy: Something you must have or do first, before you can do something else.

ex.en: Being seven years old is a requirement to join the swim team.
ex.ko: 수영 팀에 들어가려면 일곱 살이 되어야 한다.

easy: To tear something apart fast or with force.

ex.en: My pants ripped when I climbed the fence.
ex.ko: 울타리를 올라가다가 바지가 찢어졌다.

easy: A tube you look through to see faraway things.

ex.en: Dad let me look at the moon through his scope.
ex.ko: 아빠는 망원경으로 달을 볼 수 있게 해 주셨다.

easy: One part of something that fits together with other parts.

ex.en: Each segment of the toy train snaps onto the next one.
ex.ko: 장난감 기차의 각 부분은 다음 부분에 딱 끼워진다.

easy: One of the parts that something naturally divides into.

ex.en: I ate every segment of the orange.
ex.ko: 나는 오렌지 쪽을 하나도 남기지 않고 먹었다.

easy: To cut or divide something into parts.

ex.en: Mom segmented the orange so we could share it.
ex.ko: 엄마는 우리가 나눠 먹도록 오렌지를 쪽쪽 나누어 주셨다.

easy: A very strong feeling of fear.

ex.en: I screamed in terror when the lights went out.
ex.ko: 불이 꺼지자 나는 겁에 질려 비명을 질렀다.

easy: A new, exciting thing you try even though it might not work out.

ex.en: Climbing the mountain was a risky venture.
ex.ko: 그 산을 오르는 것은 위험한 모험이었다.

easy: A new business that could make money or lose money.

ex.en: Selling cookies at school was Mia's first business venture.
ex.ko: 학교에서 쿠키를 파는 것은 미아의 첫 사업 도전이었다.

easy: Almost, but not completely.

ex.en: The room was virtually empty; only one chair was left.
ex.ko: 방은 거의 비어 있었다. 의자 하나만 남아 있었다.

easy: A group of tunnels under the ground where rabbits live.

ex.en: We saw a rabbit hop into its warren.
ex.ko: 우리는 토끼가 자기 굴로 폴짝 들어가는 것을 보았다.

easy: Old and damaged because it has been used a lot.

ex.en: My sneakers are so worn that they have holes.
ex.ko: 내 운동화는 너무 닳아서 구멍이 났다.

easy: Having someone with you.

ex.en: I went to the park accompanied by my big sister.
ex.ko: 나는 누나와 함께 공원에 갔다.

easy: The strongest or most important one in a group.

ex.en: The alpha wolf leads the whole pack.
ex.ko: 우두머리 늑대가 무리 전체를 이끈다.

easy: The first letter of the Greek alphabet.

ex.en: The Greek letter alpha looks like a fish with a tail.
ex.ko: 그리스 문자 알파는 꼬리 달린 물고기처럼 생겼다.

easy: A plan you make with other people about what will happen.

ex.en: We made an arrangement to meet at the library after school.
ex.ko: 우리는 방과 후에 도서관에서 만나기로 약속했다.

easy: Things put in a certain order or way.

ex.en: Mom made a pretty flower arrangement for the table.
ex.ko: 엄마는 식탁에 예쁜 꽃꽂이를 해 놓으셨다.

easy: A hard block made of baked clay that people use to build walls.

ex.en: The third little pig built his house with bricks.
ex.ko: 셋째 아기 돼지는 벽돌로 집을 지었다.

easy: Pretty big, or a lot.

ex.en: It took a considerable amount of time to build our sandcastle.
ex.ko: 우리 모래성을 쌓는 데 상당한 시간이 걸렸다.

easy: Done in the usual way that most people do it.

ex.en: Wearing a suit to a wedding is conventional.
ex.ko: 결혼식에 정장을 입는 것은 관례적이다.

easy: A flat, round disc with a movie on it that you play on a TV or computer.

ex.en: We watched a movie on DVD on Friday night.
ex.ko: 우리는 금요일 밤에 DVD로 영화를 보았다.

easy: Paying close attention to one thing.

ex.en: Focusing on my homework helped me finish fast.
ex.ko: 숙제에 집중했더니 빨리 끝낼 수 있었다.

easy: Making a picture look clear and sharp, like with a camera.

ex.en: Focusing the camera made the bird look sharp.
ex.ko: 카메라 초점을 맞추자 새가 선명하게 보였다.

easy: To stop being angry at someone for something they did.

ex.en: I forgave my brother when he said sorry.
ex.ko: 동생이 미안하다고 해서 나는 용서해 주었다.

easy: To say that someone does not have to pay back money.

ex.en: Grandpa forgave my brother's debt of five dollars.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 형의 빚 5달러를 없던 일로 해 주셨다.

easy: A building or room where you keep a car.

ex.en: Dad parked the car in the garage.
ex.ko: 아빠는 차를 차고에 주차했다.

easy: A shop where people fix cars and trucks.

ex.en: Our car is at the garage to get a new tire.
ex.ko: 우리 차는 새 타이어를 끼우려고 정비소에 가 있다.

easy: A group of people together in one place.

ex.en: Our whole family came to the birthday gathering.
ex.ko: 온 가족이 생일 모임에 왔다.

easy: Collecting things and putting them together.

ex.en: The gathering of apples took all afternoon.
ex.ko: 사과를 따 모으는 데 오후 내내 걸렸다.

easy: Looking for answers so you can learn something.

ex.en: Our science inquiry is about why leaves change color.
ex.ko: 우리 과학 탐구는 잎이 왜 색이 변하는지에 관한 것이다.

easy: An official search to find out the facts about something important.

ex.en: The town held an inquiry into why the bridge broke.
ex.ko: 시에서는 다리가 왜 무너졌는지 조사를 열었다.

easy: A person who looks at things very carefully to check them or find facts.

ex.en: The inspector checked every room of our school for safety.
ex.ko: 검사관은 안전을 위해 우리 학교의 모든 방을 확인했다.

easy: A big wild cat from Africa. The male has long hair around its neck.

ex.en: The lion roared loudly at the zoo.
ex.ko: 사자가 동물원에서 크게 포효했다.

easy: Carrying or holding a lot of things.

ex.en: My backpack is loaded with heavy books.
ex.ko: 내 가방은 무거운 책으로 가득 차 있다.

easy: Done slowly and carefully, after thinking first.

ex.en: He gave a measured answer after thinking carefully.
ex.ko: 그는 곰곰이 생각한 뒤 신중하게 대답했다.

easy: Being kind and not punishing someone as hard as you could.

ex.en: The king showed mercy and did not punish the thief.
ex.ko: 왕은 자비를 베풀어 도둑을 벌하지 않았다.

easy: Being kind and ready to forgive others.

ex.en: She showed mercy and forgave her little brother.
ex.ko: 그녀는 자비를 베풀어 남동생을 용서해 주었다.

easy: Even so; in spite of what was just said.

ex.en: It was raining. Nevertheless, we played soccer.
ex.ko: 비가 왔다. 그래도 우리는 축구를 했다.

easy: On the outside part of something.

ex.en: The outer skin of a banana is yellow.
ex.ko: 바나나의 바깥쪽 껍질은 노랗다.

easy: On the outside of the body.

ex.en: The outer ear is the part of the ear you can see.
ex.ko: 바깥귀는 눈에 보이는 귀의 부분이다.

easy: A long tube that carries water or gas.

ex.en: Water flows through the pipe to our kitchen.
ex.ko: 물은 파이프를 따라 우리 부엌으로 흐른다.

easy: A dry material made of tiny pieces, like dust or flour.

ex.en: The chalk turned into white powder when I crushed it.
ex.ko: 분필을 부수자 하얀 가루가 되었다.

easy: A soft, dry dust you put on your skin, like baby powder.

ex.en: Mom put baby powder on my little sister.
ex.ko: 엄마는 여동생에게 베이비파우더를 발라 주셨다.

easy: Better again after being sick or hurt.

ex.en: I am fully recovered from my cold and can go to school.
ex.ko: 나는 감기가 다 나아서 학교에 갈 수 있다.

easy: Found again after being lost.

ex.en: The recovered puppy was happy to be home.
ex.ko: 되찾은 강아지는 집에 돌아와서 기뻐했다.

easy: Number seven in a row or order.

ex.en: I finished seventh in the race.
ex.ko: 나는 달리기에서 7등을 했다.

easy: One of seven equal parts.

ex.en: A week has seven days, so each day is a seventh of the week.
ex.ko: 일주일은 7일이라서 하루는 일주일의 7분의 1이다.

easy: A safe place that keeps you away from danger.

ex.en: We ran into a shelter when the storm came.
ex.ko: 폭풍이 오자 우리는 대피소로 뛰어갔다.

easy: Something over you that keeps off rain and wind.

ex.en: We found shelter under a big tree when it rained.
ex.ko: 비가 오자 우리는 큰 나무 아래에서 비를 피했다.

easy: Being kept safe from harm.

ex.en: The baby birds found shelter under their mother's wings.
ex.ko: 아기 새들은 엄마 새의 날개 아래에서 보호를 받았다.

easy: Your name written by your own hand.

ex.en: Mom wrote her signature on my permission slip.
ex.ko: 엄마는 내 동의서에 서명을 하셨다.

easy: Showing what you would like better.

ex.en: I would sooner eat noodles than rice tonight.
ex.ko: 나는 오늘 밤 밥보다 차라리 국수를 먹겠다.

easy: A small animal with eight legs that spins a web to catch bugs.

ex.en: A spider made a web on our window.
ex.ko: 거미가 우리 창문에 거미줄을 쳤다.

easy: Following the marks or footprints that a person or animal left behind.

ex.en: Tracking the deer through the snow was easy.
ex.ko: 눈 위에서 사슴을 추적하는 것은 쉬웠다.

easy: Something that makes other things start to happen.

ex.en: One small joke was the trigger that made the whole class laugh.
ex.ko: 작은 농담 하나가 반 전체를 웃게 만든 계기였다.

easy: To change or be different at different times.

ex.en: The weather here varies a lot from day to day.
ex.ko: 이곳 날씨는 하루하루 많이 달라진다.

easy: To be different from place to place or time to time.

ex.en: Prices vary from store to store.
ex.ko: 가격은 가게마다 다르다.

easy: The place where an event happens.

ex.en: The school gym is the venue for our concert.
ex.ko: 학교 체육관이 우리 음악회 장소이다.

easy: All the letters used to write a language, in order.

ex.en: I sang the ABC song with my little brother.
ex.ko: 나는 남동생과 알파벳 노래를 불렀다.

easy: Being exactly right, with no mistakes.

ex.en: She checked the accuracy of her math answers.
ex.ko: 그녀는 수학 답이 정확한지 확인했다.

easy: Made by people, not by nature.

ex.en: Those flowers are artificial, so they never die.
ex.ko: 저 꽃들은 인조라서 시들지 않는다.

easy: A very fast train that carries people.

ex.en: The bullet train goes faster than a car.
ex.ko: 고속 열차는 자동차보다 빠르게 달린다.

easy: Very well known and praised by many people.

ex.en: The celebrated singer gave a concert at our school.
ex.ko: 유명한 가수가 우리 학교에서 공연을 했다.

easy: Always in the same way, again and again.

ex.en: She consistently gets good grades because she studies every day.
ex.ko: 그녀는 매일 공부해서 꾸준히 좋은 성적을 받는다.

easy: A rule that says only the person who made a book or song can copy or sell it.

ex.en: This book has a copyright, so you cannot copy it.
ex.ko: 이 책에는 저작권이 있어서 복사할 수 없다.

easy: The earth on the ground where plants grow.

ex.en: We dug in the dirt to plant seeds.
ex.ko: 우리는 씨앗을 심으려고 흙을 팠다.

easy: Something messy that makes things not clean.

ex.en: I scrubbed the dirt off my hands.
ex.ko: 나는 손에 묻은 때를 박박 문질러 씻었다.

easy: Many and very different from each other.

ex.en: Our school has diverse students from many countries.
ex.ko: 우리 학교에는 여러 나라에서 온 다양한 학생들이 있다.

easy: Coming from God.

ex.en: Some people believe that rain is a divine gift.
ex.ko: 어떤 사람들은 비가 신이 주신 선물이라고 믿는다.

easy: Only for one person or thing, and nobody else.

ex.en: This room is used exclusively by the art club.
ex.ko: 이 방은 미술 동아리만 전용으로 쓴다.

easy: Quicker than all the others.

ex.en: Tom ran fastest of all the kids in my class.
ex.ko: 톰은 우리 반 아이들 중에서 가장 빠르게 달렸다.

easy: Made to be useful and work well.

ex.en: My backpack is functional, with lots of pockets.
ex.ko: 내 가방은 주머니가 많아서 실용적이다.
